landing.tagline: Report it. Track it. Get it fixed.
landing.hero_style: Large bold gradient typography, dark mesh glow background, quick CTA buttons for 'Report Issue' & 'Explore Feed'
landing.features: Real-time AI Categorization, Color-Coded Map Pin Tracking, Civic Gamification & Community Upvoting

citizen_mobile_app.layout: Mobile-first PWA bottom navigation bar (Feed, Map, Report +, My Reports, Leaderboard)
citizen_mobile_app.feed: Glassmorphism issue cards, category pill, distance indicator, upvote button with active state, status badge with live pulse
citizen_mobile_app.post_issue_flow: Step-by-step modal or screen with photo upload preview, simulated AI optical scanning frame effect with neon laser line animation, auto-detected tag badge, map location picker, description textarea
citizen_mobile_app.map_view: Dark interactive map backdrop with custom SVG pin markers (color-coded red/yellow/green), bouncing drop animation, pulsing urgency ring around unresolved high-priority issues
citizen_mobile_app.gamification: Points meter, civic badges (e.g., 'Street Warden', 'Pothole Patrol', 'Eco Guardian'), community leaderboard table/cards

admin_dashboard.complaint_table: Filterable issue grid with status pills, priority flags, assignment dropdowns, deadline picker, and quick detail drawer
admin_dashboard.assignment_modal: Assign task to field workers (e.g., 'Team Alpha - Road Works'), set resolution deadline, append administrative notes
admin_dashboard.analytics: Animated count-up metric cards (Total Reported, Avg Resolution Time, Active Issues, Resolved Rate), Recharts area & bar charts with dark cyan/violet gradients

field_worker_view.layout: Clean high-contrast task queue for mobile/tablet in field
field_worker_view.task_card: Issue location map shortcut, issue original photo, assigned deadline countdown, status updater button
field_worker_view.resolution_modal: Upload 'After Photo' proof, field notes entry, submit resolution completion

micro_interactions.ai_scanner: Cyan horizontal line sliding top to bottom over photo thumbnail with glowing trail (`bg-gradient-to-b from-cyan-500/0 via-cyan-400/80 to-cyan-500/0`)
micro_interactions.buttons: Hover scale 1.02, active scale 0.98, hover neon glow border
micro_interactions.cards: Staggered fade-in on mount using Framer Motion, subtle glass tilt on hover
micro_interactions.pins: Drop-down spring entrance animation on map view, pulsing radial ring for urgent tasks

testing_requirements.data_testid_rule: Every button, input, navigation link, card, badge, upvote toggle, modal trigger, tab, and table row MUST have a unique kebab-case data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use dark background `#07090E` with semi-transparent frosted cards (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-800`).
Provide clear mode switching or bottom tabs between Citizen App, Admin Dashboard, and Field Worker View.
Seed 15-20 realistic civic issues across categories (Broken Roads, Streetlights, Garbage/Waste, Water Leakage, Graffiti/Parks).
Implement the AI auto-categorization visual scan effect when uploading a photo in the Post Issue flow.

Include upvoting, distance tags, live status color badges (Pending=red, In Progress=yellow, Resolved=green), map view with custom markers, leaderboard gamification, admin worker assignment modal, and field worker completion flow.
Ensure every interactive element has a clear data-testid attribute.
